name: Errors, logs, metrics, health
summary: Structured logging, error capture, tracing, health, and metrics. Present in every product because a client whose application is down is the only situation in which every other guarantee in this system stops mattering. The per-client smoke tests generated by other capabilities are promoted into synthetic monitoring here from Phase 5.

consumes.reason: sample every event in the system for tracing and metrics

exposes.name: logger
exposes.signature: logger.info|warn|error(msg: string, fields?: Record<string, unknown>): void
exposes.description: Structured only. Values bound to a declared secret name are redacted by type before emission, never by pattern matching on key names.

exposes.name: captureError
exposes.signature: captureError(err: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): void

exposes.name: health
exposes.description: Liveness and readiness, including database and queue reachability.

external.purpose: Aggregate captured exceptions across the fleet.

smoke.name: health endpoint reports ready
smoke.asserts: /health returns 200 with database and queue reachable

smoke.name: secrets are not logged
smoke.asserts: a log call carrying a value bound to a declared credential emits a redacted field

templates.description: Next.js instrumentation hook. Wires tracing and error capture at process start.
The environment variable schema for every credential declared across the resolved graph. Fails fast at boot on a missing variable. Contains names and types only, never values.
